data.name: GitHub REST API (Repositories)
data.data_obtained: Open-source AI repository stars, forks, primary language, license, and last push date.
data.auth_required: Optional (GITHUB_TOKEN increases rate limit from 60/hr to 5,000/hr)
data.limitations: Curated set of prominent open-source AI repositories; does not fabricate trending growth velocity.

data.name: GitHub Releases API
data.data_obtained: Official AI project releases, version tags, publication dates, and release links.
data.limitations: Covers tracked open-source AI repositories; separates release creation date from publication date.

data.name: OpenRouter Models API
data.data_obtained: Model names, context windows, supported modalities, and published input/output/cached pricing.
data.rate_limit_info: Public GET endpoint; refreshed on scheduled workflow runs
data.limitations: Reflects OpenRouter routing prices, which may differ from direct first-party provider pricing.

data.name: Hugging Face Hub API
data.data_obtained: Open-weight GGUF model repositories, creators, download counts, likes, tags, and licenses.
data.auth_required: No (public Hub API; optional HF_TOKEN for higher limits)
data.rate_limit_info: Public Hub API rate limits apply
data.limitations: Open weights are not necessarily OSI open-source; always verify each model's license.

data.name: Artificial Analysis API
data.data_obtained: Intelligence index, coding index, math index, output speed (tokens/sec), and latency.
data.access_tier: Free tier available with API key & attribution
data.limitations: Requires ARTIFICIAL_ANALYSIS_API_KEY in GitHub Actions secrets. No synthetic scores are substituted.

data.name: Ollama Local API
data.data_obtained: Locally installed Ollama models on the user's machine (/api/tags).
data.limitations: Never scanned automatically. Connects only when explicitly enabled by the user in Local AI Explorer.

data.name: LMArena (Chatbot Arena)
data.auth_required: No official public REST API for automated ingestion
data.limitations: Linacre LLM Hub does not run unauthorized scrapers or fabricate Elo scores. View live human preference rankings directly on arena.ai.

data.name: MLCommons (MLPerf)
data.data_obtained: Published hardware inference & training benchmark methodology.
data.limitations: Hardware-specific results are not directly comparable to model quality benchmarks.
